---
name: Precision report
about: Tell us whether the stale warnings on your repo were any good
labels: precision
---

This is the most useful report you can file. `report --anon` drops every name and reduces
each path to its extension, so it is safe to paste from a private repo.

```
node trailstone.mjs report --anon
```

**Were the fires right?** For any that were wrong, what was the scope, and why did the file
not actually rest on that decision?

**Anything you stopped doing because the tool annoyed you?** That is the finding we want most.
